scene_007: The builder is not an unidentified character. In context, “he” refers to Noah (Mosiah 11:8–12), so the character label and prohibition against naming him are incorrect.
scene_009: The man in Mosiah 11:14–15 is Noah in the continuous account. Treating his identity as unsupplied and prohibiting that identification contradicts the supplied context.
scene_011: The group opposed by Noah’s armies is the Lamanites: “them” in Mosiah 11:18 refers back to the Lamanites in 11:17. Calling the group unidentified is incorrect.
scene_013: These words continue Abinadi’s prophecy begun in Mosiah 11:20. The claim that no human speaker can be named, and the omission of Abinadi as speaker, contradict that context.
scene_014: The speaker is Abinadi, continuing the prophecy begun in Mosiah 11:20; labeling him “Unnamed speaker” misidentifies the speaker.
